description: SANTA ANA, CA -  Keeping up his string of back-to-back endorsements, today former State Senator Lou Correa's campaign for California's 46th Congressional District seat announced an endorsement from the Orange County Labor Federation.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Lou Correa for Congress 2016
title: OC LABOR GROUPS RALLY AROUND LOU CORREA IN CA-46 — Lou Correa for Congress
